cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Expand Your Jurisdiction
cards.instruction: Use every new problem as a reason to expand what you are entitled to control.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your vans keep interrupting meetings. I taught you scheduling; send the delivery plan to me for approval.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You book rooms. I'll send our arrival times.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A good first column. Now add the routes; I'll approve those too, so your times mean something.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The council keeps closing the access road. We can't control that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You still stop at the first difficult dependency. Give the council my number; their closures need my approval against the room diary. Watch how your teacher coordinates.

reason: Make the teacher claim operate through actual corrections of B response and concrete invitations or demands, preserving exact Drive and all reply causes.
